testsuites.testsuite: <testcase name="TC-01: run at Tue 09:00 UTC settles the previous Monday 00:00 to this Monday 00:00 UTC" time="0.001786" classname="test" file="\test\settlement.test.js"/> <testcase name="TC-02: run at Tue 08:59:59 UTC is before the cut-off and settles the window one week earlier" time="0.000162" classname="test" file="\test\settlement.test.js"/>

<testcase name="TC-03: happy path pays 10 credits per completed task and notifies each account once with its total" time="0.000645" classname="test" file="\test\settlement.test.js"/> <testcase name="TC-04: cut-off boundary pays a task at exactly Monday 00:00 (start) and the last ms before the end, but not one at the end" time="0.000199" classname="test" file="\test\settlement.test.js"/> <testcase name="TC-05: timestamps with a +05:00 offset are converted to UTC before the window check" time="0.000211" classname="test" file="\test\settlement.test.js"/> <testcase name="TC-06: tasks that are not completed earn nothing and trigger no notification" time="0.000208" classname="test" file="\test\settlement.test.js"/>

<testcase name="TC-07: the same task ID twice in one batch is paid once (10 credits, one ledger entry)" time="0.000321" classname="test" file="\test\settlement.test.js"/> <testcase name="TC-08: re-running the whole settlement for the same window pays nothing new and sends no second notification" time="0.000257" classname="test" file="\test\settlement.test.js"/> <testcase name="TC-09: a retry after a partial ledger failure pays only the failed task, never the ones already paid" time="0.000379" classname="test" file="\test\settlement.test.js"/> <testcase name="TC-10: a task already paid last week and re-sent in next week's export is not paid again" time="0.000245" classname="test" file="\test\settlement.test.js"/>

<testcase name="TC-11: a notification failure is reported and does not reverse the payout" time="0.000294" classname="test" file="\test\settlement.test.js"/> <testcase name="TC-12: no notification is sent when the account's only payout failed" time="0.000164" classname="test" file="\test\settlement.test.js"/> <testcase name="TC-13: after a failed notification, the retry run delivers it exactly once and pays nothing extra" time="0.000169" classname="test" file="\test\settlement.test.js"/>
